notes.title: DEMO Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, I’m Midoriyama, the developer of [i]Don't Drop The Cake[/i].[/p][p]To coincide with the June Steam Next Fest, we’ve released a brand new [b]DEMO version[/b]—a major evolution of the original prologue![/p][p]This DEMO adds significant story elements, and you’ll finally discover: [b]Who are you delivering the cake to?[/b] Play and find out!
[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3786010/Dont_Drop_The_Cake_Demo?snr=2___"][img src="https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com//store_item_assets/steam/apps/3786010/d1bb2e88033b8e3663ad785f7cc025bd0a70225b/header.jpg?t=1749418810"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔄 Major Updates in the DEMO[/h2][list][*][p]Significant story content added[/p][/*][*][p]Continuation of the prologue storyline now playable[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Full Reset on Death mode[/b] (start from the beginning if you die!)[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced and adjusted horror effects[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle and gimmick tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Added graphic settings options[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔓 Progress Carryover to Full Release[/h2][p]If you complete the DEMO, your save data will carry over to the full game, allowing you to [b]continue right where you left off[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✉️ Feedback Welcome![/h2][p]We’d love to hear what you think— “What scared you the most?” “What features would you like to see?” Your feedback helps shape the future of the game.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]Don't Drop The Cake[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Don't Drop The Cake DEMO" Release Postponement Notice
notes.content:
Hello, this is Midoriyama, the developer of Don't Drop The Cake.

We had been preparing to release the DEMO version for the Steam Next Fest in February, but we have decided to postpone the release in order to further improve its quality.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to it. Currently, we are working on refining the horror effects, adjusting gameplay mechanics, and enhancing the story elements to provide a better experience. We kindly ask for a little more time to complete the development.

We will announce the new release date as soon as it is decided.
Thank you for your continued support of Don't Drop The Cake!

notes.title: What's Next for Don't Drop The Cake
notes.content:
What's Next for Don't Drop The Cake

Hello, this is Midoriyama, the developer of Don't Drop The Cake.
We are thrilled that so many of you have played Don't Drop The Cake: Prologue, which was released in October.

Looking ahead, we plan to release a DEMO version for the upcoming Steam Next Fest (around February 2025). This version will improve upon the Prologue and bring it much closer to the final product.

[b]Main Updates for the DEMO Version[/b]
[list]
[*] Significant additions to the story
[*] A "Full Reset on Death" mode
[*] Content that progresses slightly beyond the Prologue
[*] Enhanced and adjusted horror elements
[*] Improved puzzle mechanics
[/list]

Additionally, players who complete the DEMO version will be able to continue directly from where they left off in the full release.

While this is not a formal announcement, we are currently aiming to release the full version sometime in Spring to Summer 2025.

We will share more updates as the DEMO version release date approaches.

We would also love to hear your thoughts on the game, as well as any suggestions like, "I’d love to see this feature!" or "This could be better!" Your feedback is always welcome.

Thank you for your continued support of Don't Drop The Cake!

notes.title: "Don't Drop The Cake: Prologue," is now available
notes.content:
The prologue version of this game, "Don't Drop The Cake: Prologue" is now available. I'm grateful that more people have played it than I imagined. Since this game is being developed by a single amateur, the full release will still take some time. However, I'm working hard to make sure it becomes a game that everyone can enjoy, so I appreciate your continued support as development progresses.

[b]You can play the prologue version here.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107680/Dont_Drop_The_Cake_Prologue/
